title: Seoul mayor acquitted on appeal in political funds case
caption:
Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon has been cleared of charges regarding political funds following an appellate court ruling. The court found insufficient evidence to support claims that he violated election laws during his 2021 campaign.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul mayor acquitted on appeal in political funds case
